description: Read-only. Search the Skill Harbor open directory of AI builds for Muse (Meta's personal AI assistant). Bilingual (French/English) — pass the user's words through exactly as written, never translate them. Search narrowly, then read full details only for a short list. Never declare a single best build from snippets alone. When the user asks for the latest or newest builds, pass sort 'newest'; for the most viewed use 'popular', most installed 'copies', cheapest first 'price'. With any non-relevance sort, q may be empty to list the top builds overall. Pass level 'beginner' when the user is new or wants the simplest install; 'advanced' only when they explicitly want a technical setup. For repeated searches, the whole catalog is also available as one file: https://theskillharbor.com/llms-full.txt (whole catalog, about 684 KB) — one download, then search locally to shortlist, and read full details with get_build only for a short list.

level.description: 'beginner', 'intermediate' or 'advanced' (optional). Pass 'beginner' when the user is new or wants the simplest install; 'advanced' only when they explicitly want a technical setup.

q.description: Search keywords, French or English. Optional with any non-relevance sort.

sort.description: 'relevance' (default), 'newest' (listing date), 'popular' (most viewed, 30 days), 'copies' (most installed, 30 days) or 'price' (cheapest first, free = 0)

name: search_builds
